**Security: pass-with-notes**, delta only, at `d989fa951e5cfe21eaf77a4b620dde1c0821ea2d`.

No new injection or C19/C21 disclosure found. The earlier MEDIUM build/tree rendering block remains closed; the previous LOW lexical-scanner proof limitation and separate F127 fields are unchanged.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No new delta finding | - |

## Build-stamp scope

Both recipes now assign the three quoted stamp variables only on the `cargo build` command, not with `export`. The recipe-generated stamps therefore do not enter the subsequently launched daemon or its later jobs (`justfile:63-72,635-648`). Git-derived values remain data; no shell execution or altered authority is introduced.

The cleared-environment fake tests execute the actual `/bin/sh` recipe bodies and assert all three stamps at cargo and none at the launched fake daemon (`crates/testkit/tests/build_stamps.rs`). This proves the recipes do not add leaked stamps; it is not a guarantee that a caller's already-exported environment is sanitized.

## Bounded parsing

The whole seat report is capped at 238 bytes before `split_once`; trees at 163 bytes before `splitn(5)`; prefixes at 69 bytes before further parsing. Canonical lowercase-hex grammar and identifier-only rendering remain intact. Rejected prefixes use byte length, not a proportional character-count walk; oversize reports are not compared. Daemon stamps are validated once per digest (`crates/daemon/src/pa_watchdog.rs:1342-1433`).

Thus the added parsing/allocation work is bounded even for oversized stored reports. This does not bound the earlier storage/transport of arbitrary registration metadata or convert reported tree identity into attestation.

## Evidence and limits

Local and remote heads agree; worktree clean; PR CLEAN and ready; five successful checks and one superseded cancelled Delivers run. CI [42450838653](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42450838653) tested synthetic merge `d0f615c`, incorporating this exact head.

JUnit artifact [13605786840](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42450838653/artifacts/13605786840) has 2,208 passing cases and no failures; the runner separately reports five skipped. Confirmed passing: both build-stamp scope tests, closed grammar/widest-component/over-limit/1 MiB cases, and delivered PA-digest hostile/oversized-report containment. The reported export mutant is author evidence, not an independently rerun mutation. ddocs reported UNAVAILABLE.

No local cargo/builds/tests/scripts or fake-recipe executions, installs, credentials/global environment reads, actual daemon/digest/registration operations, product edits or pane/process probes.
